name: Hyper Gravity
description:
About This Game

Hyper Gravity

Get ready to DROP YOUR BALLS!!!. Gravity is both your friend and enemy.

Take control of a physics-driven ball and navigate a 2.5D world of ramps, drops, and increasingly challenging puzzles.

Your goal is simple: get the ball in the goal!

Master your momentum, find your flow, and use gravity to "drop your balls" for a satisfying slam dunk. Simple to learn, difficult to master, and highly addictive.

Features

  • 40 handcrafted levels – Each level brings new challenges, mechanics, and obstacles to overcome.

  • Physics-based gameplay – Every movement matters. Learn to control your momentum and master the ball.

  • Gravity boost – Harness gravity to build speed and traverse the geometry.

  • A challenge worth conquering – Progress through increasingly demanding courses where precision and patience are everything.

  • Relaxing atmosphere – Take in the scenery, enjoy the ambient soundtrack, and breathe between the failed attempts.

No enemies. No timers. No unnecessary distractions.

Just you, a ball, and gravity.

How far can you roll?
short_desc: A physics-based platforming challenge where you harness gravity to roll, bounce, and dribble a gravity ball through 40 handcrafted challenges. Master your momentum, find your flow, and get the ball in the goal!
